details.description: BOSS offers sophisticated, modern collections focused on quality and design to create an impeccable look.
details.name: BOSS

details.description: More than twenty-five years after the brand’s creation, its fundamentals are still the same: Isabel Marant remains the most unruly of the great French fashion houses.
details.name: Isabel Marant

details.description: Whether travelling for business or leisure, city breaks or long haul, holidays or day-to-day, Samsonite has the perfect bag for every occasion.
details.name: Samsonite

details.description:
Produciendo piezas de lujo desde 1913, Prada es sinónimo de calidad sin compromisos y de innovación y diseño.
Prada se centra en materiales valiosos, duraderos y encapsula sofisticadas técnicas de fabricación. Prada se ha convertido en un conocido nombre familiar, amado por clientes de todo el mundo.
details.name: Prada

details.description: The Venezuelan-born fashion designer launched this lifestyle brand in 2008, which includes womenswear, eyewear, handbags and jewellery. The label owes its timeless quality to Herrera’s dictum of elegance combined with intricacy. The combination works, as she can count many high-profile fans including Renée Zellweger, Jackie Onassis, Nicole Kidman, Caroline Kennedy, and Meryl Streep.
details.name: CH Carolina Herrera

details.description: View on map
details.name: Gucci

details.description:
NEW BOUTIQUE
Versace returns to its usual location in Las Rozas Village. Come meet our new more luxurious space from 7 of March, next to Furla. Check de Village map for more information.
Founded in 1978, Versace is one of the leading global fashion design houses. Under the artistic direction of Donatella Versace since 1997, Versace designs, manufactures, distributes and retails fashion and lifestyle products including haute couture, woman and man ready-to-wear, jewellery, watches, accessories, fragrances and furniture.
details.name: Versace

details.description: Michael Kors is a world-renowned, award-winning designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear. His namesake company, established in 1981, is an influential global presence with over 500 stores in more than 85 countries worldwide, as well as wholesale distribution to top department stores worldwide. The brand currently produces a range of products under the signature Michael Kors Collection and Michael Kors labels. These products include accessories, footwear, watches, jewelry, men's and women's ready-to-wear, swimwear, eyewear and a full line of fragrance products. With an innate sense of glamour, Michael Kors offers a luxury lifestyle for the consummate jet setter that is as sophisticated as it is indulgent and as iconic as it is modern.
details.name: Michael Kors

details.description:
LOEWE is one of the world's major luxury brands. With more than 170 years of history, it is defined by the modernity of its past, an unwavering confidence in the present, and a firm look forward.
LOEWE was founded in Spain and remains the brand's home. While its current landscape contains elements from places near and far and the Spanish legacy is expressed in modern ways, the heart of LOEWE still beats in Madrid, where all of its world-renowned leather goods continue to be manufactured. Jonathan Anderson is LOEWE’s creative director and he started a new chapter for LOEWE, presenting itself to the world more multi-faceted and dynamic than ever. Anderson's first ready-to-wear collections for LOEWE were presented in 2014. Streamlined, ultra-soft leather accessories are given a playful dynamic in the shapes of animals, and the T Pouch, now a bestseller, is the perfect accessory.
Craftsmanship, progress and unequalled expertise with leather, LOEWE's founding pillars, are reconfigured with a timely awareness evident in desirable and functional products across multiple categories, including ready-to-wear, accessories, home and lifestyle.
details.name: Loewe

details.description: Enjoy the temporary boutique of the urban fashion brand from Madrid (made with love) that is a hit with Gen Z.
details.name: Scuffers

details.description:
Maje is, above all, a family story of Judith Milgrom.
Founded in Paris in 1998, the brand offers a bold, modern and urban style. The brand’s first store opened on the left bank of the Seine, in the 6th district of Paris and is now present across 37 countries with 448 points of sale. Over the years, Maje has successfully developed a wide collection ranging from ready-to-wear to accessories and has managed to establish itself as a leading brand of accessible luxury. Built on both trend-led and classic pieces with subtle details and twists, the brand has a resolutely feminine silhouette that is understated yet glamorous.
details.name: Maje

details.description: For more than 100 years, Montblanc has embraced the traditions of lasting value and exquisite craftsmanship. The brand’s uncompromising principles of design, style, quality and workmanship have allowed it to create heirloom collections that are passed from generation to generation. The iconic Montblanc emblem is a symbol of excellence – the pinnacle of luxury writing instruments, timepieces, leather, accessories, fragrances and sunglasses.
details.name: Montblanc

details.description: International tradition dating back more than 280 years. In 2011 ZWILLING celebrated 280 years of existence. The white and red ZWILLING logo has become a well-known emblem of a sophisticated lifestyle. Known for their high quality kitchen products, cutlery and beauty instruments, the brand’s unique success story is one of customer satisfaction across state borders. The innovative products still set benchmarks because they are always designed to meet the customer’s needs. Today the wide variety of products and offers is reflected under the umbrella brand of ZWILLING J.A. HENCKELS AG.
details.name: Zwilling J.A. Henckels

details.description: Italian womenswear brand Liu Jo offers a feminine style characterised by balance and refinement. Established in 1995, in the heart of the textile district of Carpi, Modena, the label launched with a knitwear collection. Today the Liu Jo line offers glamour, with a range of fashion and accessories embellished with crystals, sequins and embroidery.
details.name: LIU·JO

details.description: This Spanish fashion designer and gifted fabric expert creates subtle, understated, contemporary clothing. Purificación García was born in a Galician village in northwest Spain, but moved to Uruguay, where she learnt her trademark expertise in materials while working for a textile company. After her own collection met with critical acclaim at Milan in 1989, Purificación García has expanded her elegant style into men and women’s ready-to-wear, perfume, eyewear and other accessories.
details.name: Purificación García

details.description: “The sun, the products of the soil and a love of nature are the essence of my Provence". L’Occitane founder Olivier Baussan describes the inspiration behind a company that, despite being over 30 years old and world renowned, continues to work from the small Provençal town of Manosque. There is something for every whim, from almond shower oil to shea butter foot cream made with lavender oil and arnica extract – all produced using high quality, traceable, natural ingredients.
details.name: L'Occitane en Provence

details.description: The world's best-selling sunglasses brand was born in 1937 when Bausch & Lomb created anti-glare shades for the US Army Air Corps. The Aviator became an eyewear icon when General Douglas MacArthur was photographed wearing them during World War Two, and join the Wayfarer as the brand’s most recognisable styles. Today the name Ray-Ban is synonymous with stylish sunglasses, as the company innovates with design and colour to provide eyewear to suit everyone.
details.name: Ray-Ban

details.description: Hour Passion is a specialist multi-brand watch boutique, housing some of the most exciting and globally revered Swiss Made brands to include LONGINES, RADO, TISSOT, CERTINA, MIDO, HAMILTON, CALVIN KLEIN WATCHES + JEWELRY AND BALMAIN. Hour Passion prominently houses each brand in its own individual retail space, allowing you a closer look at the brands’ unique features. Make time for Hour Passion and marvel at your next extraordinary timepiece.
details.name: Hour Passion

details.description:
The brand PHILIPP PLEIN was founded in Munich in 1998 by the designer and owner Philipp Plein. Today, he designs clothes, accessories and interiors with lines that interpret a contemporary and new cosmopolitan style. The perfection of detail, combined with an irreverent spirit, creates a new concept of luxury and another type of elegance. Everything strictly done in Italy. The unusual and meticulous use of fine materials, combined with the original, makes each piece unique.
What really counts is giving life to imagination and precision, to a product that will remain eternally authentic.
details.name: Philipp Plein

details.description: BIMANI goes beyond fashion: it is a community of women who choose to dress with freedom, awareness and purpose.
details.name: Bimani

details.description: Synonymous with khaki trousers, the San Francisco label offers clothing that is rugged enough for the outdoors yet suitable for leisurely getaways and informal business meetings. Flattering and stylish trousers are available in both men’s and women’s styles.
details.name: Dockers

details.description: Zadig&Voltaire is all about casual-chic: it is a state of mind, a musical inclination, fashion as a bold statement.
details.name: Zadig&Voltaire®

details.description: Con sus orígenes en Barcelona, BROWNIE es una marca para mujeres de espíritu joven fundada en 2006. En la actualidad, cuenta con un equipo de más de 600 personas y 100 tiendas repartidas por España, Portugal, Andorra, Francia, México, Chile, Colombia, Uruguay e Israel, así como un canal de venta online multilingüe
details.name: Brownie

details.description:
Diesel has long been a leading pioneer in denim and casual fashion.
It rocks the world of premium casual wear, being a true alternative to the established luxury market. Through its journey, Diesel’s philosophy is the same as when Renzo Rosso created it in 1978: he envisaged a brand that stands for passion, individuality and self-expression.
Although Diesel has been paving the road for denim trends since, its attitude has also expanded to encompass every aspect of modern life.
From distinctive apparel, accessories and underwear, to watches, eyewear, fragrance, furniture and children’s wear, Diesel has you covered every step of the way.
details.name: Diesel

details.description: Marc Jacobs International was established in 1984, driven by a deep passion for fashion and a strong dedication to quality craftsmanship.
details.name: Marc Jacobs

details.description: For 15 years, two friends, Barbara and Sharon reinvent femininity through an ideal wardrobe. More than fashion, ba&sh is a complete state of mind, a unique vision to make women beautiful and good.
details.name: ba&sh

details.description: This world-renowned luxury brand, founded by a young Czech glasscutter in 1895, offers collectable crystal in myriad forms, including jewellery, figurines and vases. Swarovski crystals have decorated everything from a chandelier in the film The Phantom of the Opera to the 9-foot-diameter star that tops the Christmas tree in New York’s Rockefeller Center, and countless designer’s collections. Today the signature swan logo graces delicate, impeccably crafted gifts from jewels and charms to home accessories.
details.name: Swarovski

details.description: Enticing fashions from sisters María and Uxía Domínguez for women who like to layer garments and accessories in playful, unpredictable ways. Aimed at working women aged 25 to 45, the gracefully feminine portfolio includes jackets and blouses, shoes and belts, bags and cases, costume jewellery, scarves, hats and head-dresses. The greyhound logo comes from Uxía’s love of dogs and expresses the brand’s dynamic elegance.
details.name: Bimba y Lola

details.description: The North Face® was founded in 1966 with the goal of preparing outdoor athletes for the rigors of their next adventure
details.name: The North Face

details.description: Furla is a premium accessories brand whose style codes are defined by an upbeat and inspiring Italian lifestyle. A fusion of contemporary design, top quality craftsmanship and an upbeat edge that make the difference. Made with the finest Italian leather, Furla’s pieces are unique and innovative offering contemporary designs injected with a playful, colourful and joyful edge. Since 1927, Furla engages and inspires women across the board.
details.name: Furla

details.description:
Spring 2019 presents iconic styles that that have been updated ever so slightly without straying too far from Polo’s DNA. For men, a military surplus-themed group arrives alongside colorful classics with endless wear possibilities. The women’s assortment ranges from always-chic silhouettes in black and white to menswear-inspired pieces styled in anything-but-masculine ways. From the playground to the classroom, children’s arrivals in a mix of upbeat colors, florals, and stripes strike a playful tone.

Women’s Polo is a celebration of American style viewed under a modern lens. Elevated icons in navy and white with splashes of red–including blazers, tailored pants, and Bengal stripes–are updated in relaxed proportions. Among the highlighted looks is a moto-style jacket in distressed calfskin teamed with a striped shirt and a drape pant. Multi-colored knits and sweaters perfectly complement the fashion-forward styles. For the on-the-go Polo woman, a minimal palette of black and white separates pulls double duty. Neutral tones punctuated by bold prints and colors are paired with foundational fabrics take her wardrobe from work to weekend and beyond.
details.name: Polo Ralph Lauren Women

images.altText: Logo for Polo Ralph Lauren Women

For men, a military surplus-themed group arrives alongside colorful classics with endless wear possibilities. The women’s assortment ranges from always-chic silhouettes in black and white to menswear-inspired pieces styled in anything-but-masculine ways. From the playground to the classroom, children’s arrivals in a mix of upbeat colors, florals, and stripes strike a playful tone.
details.name: Polo Ralph Lauren Children

images.altText: Logo for Polo Ralph Lauren Children

details.description: Founded in 2009, the Spanish menswear brand seeks to highlight the essence of its wearers during every moment of the day with its Casual, Sport and Tailoring collections.
details.name: Silbon

details.description: Vans, makers of the original skate shoe since 1966, create authentic performance board shoes plus street-meets-beach attire. While the Californian brand’s classic Era and Slip-on styles can still be found in shoe stores around the globe, each season sees special releases drawing on many influences, from reinventing heritage sneakers to working with the rock bands and up-and-coming illustrators that inspire Vans designers and its loyal fans.
details.name: Vans

details.description: Bronx-born Klein started out with a coat shop in the York Hotel in New York City in the 1960s but by the early 70s, he was producing menswear, womenswear and award-winning underwear collections. A household name today, some would say you’re not properly dressed unless you’re wearing Calvin Klein underwear, sporting the distinctive logo.
details.name: Calvin Klein Underwear

details.description: The jeans brand known for both its innovative fit and ground-breaking advertising campaigns, which launched the international careers of the likes of Kate Moss and Mark Wahlberg. Klein could be credited with inventing the designer jeans craze in the 1970s by putting his name on the back pocket.
details.name: Calvin Klein Jeans

details.description: A globally recognised lifestyle brand, Tommy Hilfiger’s signature flag logo symbolises high-end quality that customers worldwide associate with luxury and quintessential American prep. The launch of their iconic men’s sportswear range in 1985 led to the expansion of the brand’s clothing range to encompass a complete premium collection for men, women, and kids. Today, in its 30th year, Tommy Hilfiger dresses the whole family and is a much-loved fashion brand.
details.name: Tommy Hilfiger

details.description: The original BIRKENSTOCK footbed is an ergonomic design crafted to mimic the natural feel of walking barefoot. It’s contoured to match the foot’s shape, providing stability, arch support, and smooth, comfortable movement with each step.
details.name: Birkenstock

details.description: New Balance® is a global leader in athletic footwear and apparel. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts since 1906, New Balance continues to be driven by the relentless desire to improve.
details.name: New Balance

details.description:
Spring 2019 presents iconic styles that that have been updated ever so slightly without straying too far from Polo’s DNA. For men, a military surplus-themed group arrives alongside colorful classics with endless wear possibilities. The women’s assortment ranges from always-chic silhouettes in black and white to menswear-inspired pieces styled in anything-but-masculine ways. From the playground to the classroom, children’s arrivals in a mix of upbeat colors, florals, and stripes strike a playful tone.

Men’s Polo kicks off with a collection based in a surplus sensibility. Capturing the spirit are flight jackets, complemented by tan and khaki sportswear with military-inspired details. Contemporary styles, which range from long-sleeved Polo shirts to chambray sport shirts, bridge the gap between surplus and sporty. Rendered in grey and white, these pieces serve as a palette cleanser before the arrival of updated staples in a broad, saturated color palette that’s easy to mix and match. A shawl collar layered over a poplin sport shirt, for example, take the Polo man from garden party to casual cookout.
details.name: Polo Ralph Lauren Men

images.altText: Logo for Polo Ralph Lauren Men

details.description: Founded in Holland in the year 2000, Rituals is the first cosmetic brand that combines body care products with cosmetics for home. Based on natural ingredients and fragrances created by the best perfumers of the world. The philosophy of Rituals is simple: happiness can be found in the smallest things. Our passion is to transform your daily routines into the most valuable rituals. Just enjoy a few minutes of simple things like a hot water bath, a cup of tea or a massage.
details.name: Rituals

details.description:
Founded in 1978 on the coast of California by an Australian surfer, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot.
First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG® has since expanded beyond the icon to design footwear, apparel, accessories, and home decor with an uncompromising attitude toward creativity, quality and craftsmanship.
Bold, provocative, free-spirited, optimistic, and real, the brand has always celebrated unapologetic individuality and continues to be embraced globally by those who refuse to be defined by convention.
details.name: UGG

details.description: Founded in New York City in 2004, Tory Burch has redefined American luxury with a global point of view. The company’s purpose is to empower women and women entrepreneurs.
details.name: Tory Burch

details.description: The world's best-selling sunglasses brand was born in 1937 when Bausch & Lomb created anti-glare shades for the US Army Air Corps. The Aviator became an eyewear icon when General Douglas MacArthur was photographed wearing them during World War Two, and join the Wayfarer as the brand’s most recognisable styles. Today the name Ray-Ban is synonymous with stylish sunglasses, as the company innovates with design and colour to provide eyewear to suit everyone.
details.name: Sunglass Hut

details.description: Boggi Milano is an Italian menswear brand with 280 stores in 65 countries. Focused on innovation, technology, sustainability and quality, it uses premium materials and technical fabrics to create modern, functional menswear.
details.name: Boggi

details.description: Discover the world of Lindt: over 170 years of Swiss chocolate tradition, crafted with passion and perfection.
details.name: Lindt

details.description: Coach is a modern American luxury brand with a rich heritage rooted in quality and craftsmanship. All over the world, the Coach name is synonymous with the ease and sophistication of New York style.
details.name: Coach

details.description: Adolfo Dominguez is a global designer fashion label, founded by eponymous designer, in the 1970s. With a renowned reputation for quality and elegance, Adolfo Dominguez designs, manufactures and distributes a broad range of women’s and men’s ready-to-wear products and accessories. The Adolfo Dominguez target market is “the immense minority” – in the memorable words of Juan Ramón Jiménez – not for purchasing power or social status, but the intellectually refined.
details.name: Adolfo Dominguez

details.description: Valentino is synonymous of inclusiveness, uniqueness and creativity.
details.name: Valentino Garavani

details.description: Since 1975, TUMI has been creating world-class business and travel essentials, designed to upgrade, uncomplicate, and beautify all aspects of life on the move. Blending flawless functionality with a spirit of ingenuity, we’re committed to empowering journeys as a lifelong partner to movers and makers in pursuit of their passions. Designed in America, for Global Citizens everywhere. The brand is sold globally in over 75 countries through more than 1,900 points of sale.
details.name: Tumi

details.description: Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, Columbia Sportswear Company has been making gear so that Pacific Northwesterners can enjoy the outdoors for more than 70 years. At the helm for over 40 years has been our Chairman, Gert Boyle. Her Tough Mother persona has grown Columbia into the global sportswear company that it is today–still based in Portland, still making no-nonsense apparel and footwear to keep you warm, dry, cool and protected no matter what. Our unique Pacific Northwest heritage and Boyle family irreverence is what sets us apart from the competition.
details.name: Columbia

details.description: Timberland is the urban outdoor lifestyle brand best known for its original Yellow Boot introduced in 1973. Today Timberland outfits consumers from toe-to-head, with versatile collections rooted into the brand’s rich heritage of utility, craftsmanship and style. Timberland’s dedication to making quality products is matched by an unwavering commitment to innovate and operate in a responsible manner – in terms of our products, the outdoors, and the communities around the globe where we live, work and explore.
details.name: Timberland

details.description: Flabelus combines the best of two worlds: the impeccable design of timeless footwear and the strength, comfort and quality of centuries-old Spanish techniques: those used to make espadrilles.
details.name: Flabelus

details.description:
In 1975 Giorgio Armani founded his company in Milan. Since then, he has established his name as a world leader in fashion and accessory design with his brands Emporio Armani and Armani Jeans. His style is synonymous with luxury and contemporary elegance, modernity and sophistication, as expressed also in his interior design and home accessory brand Armani Home.
“Exclusive watch collections for Ladies and Men now in store”
details.name: Armani

details.description:
Jimmy Choo is a 21st century luxury accessories brand, with shoes at its heart, offering an empowered sense of glamour and a playfully daring spirit.
The brand traces its roots to a bespoke shoemaker named Jimmy Choo, based in the East End of London in the early 1990s, who catered to the global jet set, including Princess Diana. The Jimmy Choo company was founded in 1996, with Mr Choo’s niece, Sandra Choi, who had been heading up design in the East End atelier, coming on board as Creative Director, a position she holds to this day.
Today, Jimmy Choo encompasses a complete luxury accessories brand. Women's shoes remain the core of the product offer, alongside handbags, small leather goods, scarves, sunglasses, eyewear, belts, fragrance and men's shoes.
details.name: Jimmy Choo

details.description: The Cosmetics Company Store is the official discount outlet for world-renowned brands offering beauty products for men and women including make-up, skincare, brushes and fragrances.
details.name: The Cosmetics Company Store

images.altText: Logo for The Cosmetics Company Store

details.description: Established in 1856, Burberry is a British brand with a heritage of innovation, craftsmanship and design. Based in London under the direction of Chief Creative and Chief Executive Officer Christopher Bailey, the brand has a global reputation for functionality with a unique British sensibility. The company began with the invention of gabardine, the weatherproof fabric patented by Thomas Burberry, who later designed the trench coat, which retains its iconic status today.
details.name: Burberry

details.description: TOUS is a happy go lucky brand for those that are young at heart. A family run business founded in 1920, the brand is available in more than 40 countries, with boutiques in cities such as New York, Mexico City and Tokyo. Its endearing icon, the bear, is loved the world over. TOUS’ designs are fresh and on-trend. The brand provides a wide array of products including jewellery, bags, fragrances, sunglasses and accessories that make perfect gifts. The TOUS stores are a unique buying experience in themselves, immersing the customer in a magical world of jewels and accessories. Their staff provide an exemplary personalised advisory and after-sales service.
details.name: TOUS

details.description: Scalpers is a men's fashion brand that dresses the urban, cosmopolitan man, the sports, culture and art aficionados, those that are interested in new technology, gastronomy and travel. The discerning man that values attention to detail; who is what he wears and requires a brand that accompanies him wherever he goes. Scalpers started out selling exclusive ties. From there it moved in to customised tailoring, which then led on to its first ready-to-wear collection, as well as, of course, its signature slippers. In 2010 it opened its first Flagship Store in Madrid (Calle Velázquez, 47), which is a must see when it comes to style and being on trend. A modern space that blends both art and fashion.
details.name: Scalpers

details.description: This young label from France gives women and men effortless chic with fashion that manages to be ultra-hip, romantic and voluptuous all at once. Founded by Evelyne Chétrite in 2005, it opened its first boutique on rue Vieille du Temple, Paris, the brand now has boutiques all over the world, providing wearable, casual fashion and accessories with a bohemian air.
details.name: Sandro

details.description: lululemon is a Canadian brand of performance clothing that puts sensation at the heart of its vision.
details.name: lululemon

details.description: Tapping British culture of the 1960s and 70s, and exuding a nostalgic, preppy look, brothers Alvaro and Clemente Cebrian have introduced something different to the fashion scene for young Spanish men and women. With the spotlight on fabric quality, the side show is the fun details such as tartan linings and unusual braiding.
details.name: El Ganso

details.description: A classic since right now. Meet the only jeans you’ll ever need! Since invented in 1873, the Levi’s® Jean has been a blank canvas for self-expression. Always original. Today, Levi’s® continues to evolve through a relentless innovative spirit. Visit the Levi’s® store now and find your new favorite pair of Levi’s® at special outlet prices. Express your personal style and show the world how you Live in Levi’s®.
details.name: Levi's

details.description: ETRO is an iconic Italian luxury brand known for its colorful Paisley prints on quality fabrics.
details.name: Etro

details.description:
The Clarins brand was born in 1954, founded by Jacques Courtin-Clarins when he opened his first beauty spa on rue Tronchet in Paris. Jacques Courtin-Clarins formulated the first face and body oils, which are 100% natural, based on pure plant extracts. 
Since its inception, Clarins has continued to be inspired by nature and its science for the creation of its beauty products.
More than 60 years later, Clarins remains true to its values:
listening to women, effectiveness, innovation, research and respect for the environment.
details.name: Clarins

details.description: Aristocrazy is an international brand born in 2010. It has created a new jewellery concept combining the quality, tradition and know-how of the Spanish Suárez Group, with contemporary design and the latest fashion trends. Leaders in fashion jewellery, their current and distinctive designs offer their own brand personality at affordable prices. Aristocrazy brings freedom to the jewellery world.
details.name: Aristocrazy

details.description: Cast-iron specialist company Le Creuset was born in 1924 when two Belgian industrialists, Armand Desaegher and Octave Aubecq, met at the Brussels Fair. A year later they established a foundry in Aisne, France and started producing reassuringly heavy, enamelled cookware in a riot of rustic colours. Today, the durability of this iconic brand’s products means they are handed down from generation to generation, becoming part of a family’s domestic heritage.
details.name: Le Creuset

details.description: Elevating everyday jewellery Born in Barcelona in 2015, PDPAOLA is the brainchild of brothers Paola and Humbert Sasplugas. Its mission is to create a brand that revolutionises the jewellery sector, uniting it with the world of fashion.
details.name: PDPAOLA

details.description: Leading the race of time since 1860 is the tradition and expertise of this swiss watchmaker. Tag Heuer has been the timekeeping brand for Formula 1 since 1959, due to the accuracy of its chronographs. Now in 2014, it promotes the new era of motorsport as a founding member of the Formula E. Never yielding to the pressure Tag Heuer always innovates by breaking the rules.
details.name: TAG Heuer

details.description: Dolce & Gabbana is authentic, unconventional and expressive
details.name: Dolce & Gabbana

details.description: Sexy, adventurous, trend-setting apparel and accessories for men and women from the American brand started by four entrepreneurial Moroccan brothers in 1981. The Marciano brothers, who had moved to California via France, hit the ground running with their distinctive stone-washed jeans which became a huge hit and established the brand in the US.
details.name: Guess

details.description: Kenzo offers a luxuriant and versatile world where spontaneity takes control.
details.name: Kenzo

details.description: PANDORA is an international jewellery brand founded in 1982 in Denmark. Its mission is to celebrate women by offering them the opportunity for personal expression through their universe of high-quality and contemporary jewellery at affordable prices. PANDORA jewellery is genuine , contemporary and feminine and inspire women to express their individuality.
details.name: Pandora

details.description: UNOde50 was founded in the late 1990s by a group of designers who resolved to establish a brand of fashion jewellery and accessories that would break all existing moulds. The project was based on the creation of pieces with a unique and distinctive style, which soon became known for their flair and innovation. This fusion of tradition and modernity was the breeding ground for a new and different brand, steeped in a spirit of craftsmanship and signalling exclusivity through its design and quality.
details.name: UNOde50

details.description:
Life is a beautiful sport
Lacoste was born with a simple action. In 1933, tennis champion René Lacoste cut the sleeves off his shirt to gain ease of movement on the court. The polo came into being, the crocodile too. Behind the simplicity of the gesture is innovation. Ever since, Lacoste reinvents itself with each collection. Between technical performance, minimal style and French elegance: Silhouettes in perfect balance.
Polo Capsule for Men Jean-Paul Goude
The iconic Lacoste polo for men is updated with a brand new crocodile logo. Available in both short and long-sleeved version, it makes for a perfectly unique holiday gift.
This holiday season, the crocodile goes on an unusual journey – an idea that came about after Felipe Oliveira Baptista, the house’s creative director, met Jean-Paul Goude, a celebrated French graphic artist. The former gave the latter carte blanche to design not only the logo on limited-edition polos and leather goods, their packagings and window displays, but also to conceive and create the Lacoste holiday campaign. The result is the iconic crocodile is seen through the eyes of Jean-Paul Goude: the imaginary Africa of his childhood, his love of dance and his infatuation with the Bauhaus.
details.name: Lacoste

details.description: Under Armour’s mission is to make all athletes better through passion, design and the relentless pursuit of innovation. Founded in 1996 by former University of Maryland football player Kevin Plank, Under Armour is the originator of performance apparel – gear engineered to keep athletes cool and dry throughout the course of a game, practice or workout.
details.name: Under Armour

details.description: Proud of her Italian heritage, Elisabetta Franchi created her eponymous brand in 2012 to dress the modern woman.
details.name: Elisabetta Franchi

The brand celebrates his colossal legacy and breathes his passion, intuition and inexhaustible creativity into the core of its DNA.
